is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses exclusively on Culex pipiens pallens, a mosquito species that is not an Anopheles vector.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports kdr mutations (L1014F and L1014S) in Culex pipiens pallens.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 provides genotype counts for kdr mutations across different generations and strains.

african_field_population.evidence: The mosquitoes were collected in China (Tangkou, Shandong Province).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical laboratory selection study.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies the collection site as Tangkou, Shandong Province, China.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study covers a period of approximately 28 months (30 generations).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a primary laboratory selection experiment.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study investigates the development of pyrethroid resistance in a laboratory-selected population of Culex pipiens pallens collected from China. It monitors kdr mutations and metabolic enzyme activities over 30 generations under different selection pressures.
